liz-martin: Heads up — saw a spike of failed edge cert rotations in ap-southeast about 02:12 UTC. ACME hook kept retrying and never completed.
ankur: Can you paste the log snippet? Could be a KMS decrypt issue with the rotator key.
liz-martin: Log shows repeated errors from keystore-unwrapper:
```
2026-03-21T02:12:03Z keystore-unwrapper ERROR KMSDecryptError: projects/prod/locations/asia/keyRings/edge/cryptoKeys/rotator: Decrypt denied for serviceAccount:edge-rotator-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
CausedBy: IAMBindingNotFound
```
sam: Confirmed — an automated IAM cleanup job ran at 02:15 UTC and removed a handful of bindings. I see the `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` binding for edge-rotator-sa was removed. :grimacing:
infra-bot: rollback initiated for rotator deployment -> commit 6a1f8b3 (rollback reason: cert rotation failures).
maya: I re-added the decrypt role to edge-rotator-sa (manually) and forced a rotation. Hooks resumed and new certs provisioned at 02:27 UTC. :thumbsup:
raj: Good catch. Two quick concerns:
  1) Why did the IAM cleanup target that SA? Is it in the allowlist? (we recently tightened allowlist rules)
  2) We had KMS Decrypt denies in the log but our audit sink/filtering dropped DATA_ACCESS entries for KMS — we don't have the deny events retained anywhere.
ankur: Looks like recent allowlist pruning used a pattern that filtered on `serviceAccount:*-bot` and edge-rotator-sa slipped through since it doesn't match our naming policy. I'll update the cleanup regex. Also adding an explicit exemption for `edge-rotator-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` in the allowlist.
maya: About audit logs — the logging sink to the security-project excludes `DATA_ACCESS` by default. KMS decrypt denies are in DATA_ACCESS category. We need to add a sink to capture KMS DATA_ACCESS for the prod keyring at least for 30 days. Filing ticket INFRA-3721.
sam: Actionable items I can take now:
  - Reconcile the cleanup job allowlist and add exemption (owner: ankur)
  - Add a KMS DATA_ACCESS sink for `projects/redwood-prod/locations/asia/keyRings/edge` to security logs (owner: maya)
  - Add an alert on repeated KMS DecryptDenied for rotator key (owner: raj)
  - Add an integration test in rotator CI that runs a decrypt using edge-rotator-sa against a test key before a canary (owner: liz-martin)

liz-martin: I'll put a tiny smoke test into the rotator pipeline today; it will catch missing IAM perms before deploy. ETA: EOD.
raj: I'll make the alert (SIG on 3 denies within 5m). We should also emit an incident annotation when rotation fails so customers on Dedicated/Dedicated-like tiers can be proactively notified.
maya: Quick note — re-adding roles manually is a mitigation but we should avoid manual fixes going forward. Propose: (a) allowlist fix, (b) CI smoke test, (c) logging sink + alert, (d) periodic IAM binding audit job that reports drift to #eng-security. Anyone object?
ankur: No objections. I'll push allowlist change after code review and add the exemption.
sam: I'll add a postmortem draft to the incidents board with TL;DR and RCA once we confirm cleanup config was the root cause.
liz-martin: Thanks team. Closing the immediate rotation issue. Follow-ups tracked: INFRA-3721 (logging sink), IAM-PR #564 (allowlist exemption), ROTATOR-CI-12 (smoke test), ALERT-121 (kms decrypt denies). :eyes:
infra-bot: Created incident INC-2026-0312-07 (owner: sam).
